raw.cause: While handling nav's MSG_POSITION (63860/63870), gps_handle() calls MsgSend() back to nav for a MSG_HINT (63971). nav's only thread is REPLY-blocked in its own MsgSend() to gps, so it never reaches MsgReceive(): gps stays SEND-blocked on nav, nav stays REPLY-blocked on gps, and display stays REPLY-blocked on nav behind them. The gps -> nav send is also not in the contract, which allows only nav -> gps.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in gps (gps_handle sends MSG_HINT to nav while nav is blocked sending to gps)
raw.fix_summary: Remove the reverse call. gps is a server below nav and must answer MSG_POSITION from its own state, never by sending to its client. If gps really needs route context, nav should put it in the MSG_POSITION request (for example in msg->text). The contract (allow: nav -> gps only) already forbids gps -> nav, so the code should change, not the contract.
